invoice_id.description: Unique invoice identifier, printed as `Faktura VAT {invoice_id} oryginal`

invoice_date.description: Date of issue and date of delivery/service completion, both printed with this same value, format YYYY-MM-DD

place_of_issue.description: City where the invoice was issued, printed as `Miejsce wystawienia`

order_id.description: Source sales order identifier this invoice was raised for, printed as `Order ID`

invoice_status.description: Status of the invoice as printed next to the order ID

buyer.description: Buyer information, printed in the `Nabywca` box

country.description: Country of the buyer, printed as `Kraj`

seller.description: Seller information, printed in the header and in the `Sprzedawca` box

street.description: Street and building/flat number of the seller, printed as one combined address line

tax_id.description: Tax ID (NIP) of the seller, printed as `NIP`

totals.description: Invoice totals, printed in the `Razem` and `Razem do zaplaty` summary boxes

currency.description: Currency code the invoice amounts are expressed in, printed next to `Razem do zaplaty`

total_net_amount.description: Total net amount for the whole invoice

total_tax_amount.description: Total tax amount for the whole invoice

total_gross_amount.description: Total gross amount for the whole invoice, printed as `Razem do zaplaty`

items.description: List of items grouped by tax level. This synthetic generator always produces one tax level with one item, but the schema keeps the grouping so it also fits invoices with several VAT rates

tax_level.description: Tax level - VAT percentage rate printed in the `VAT [%]` column. Each item can have a separate tax level

items.description: List of items for this tax level

name.description: Name of the item, printed in the `Nazwa` column

quantity.description: Quantity of the item, printed in the `Ilosc` column

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure of the item, printed in the `j.m.` column, e.g. `szt.`

unit_price.description: Net unit price of the item, printed in the `Cena netto` column

item_net_amount.description: Net amount for the item, printed in the `Wartosc netto` column

item_tax_amount.description: Tax amount for the item, printed in the `Kwota VAT` column

item_gross_amount.description: Gross amount for the item, printed in the `Wartosc brutto` column
